titles.title: Ocean-Based Climate Solutions Act of 2022
titles.titleType: Short Title(s) as Reported to House

titles.title: To direct the Administrator of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration to provide for ocean-based climate solutions to reduce carbon emissions and global warming; to make coastal communities more resilient; and to provide for the conservation and restoration of ocean and coastal habitats, biodiversity, and marine mammal and fish populations; and for other purposes.
